description_ru: Озерно-болотные отложения. Торф, глины, супеси, пески
note: GGK-200/1 Q-41-III, Severo-Uralskaya series, Quaternary map 1st ed. 1962 (printed 1964, author K.K. Vollosovich), RASTER (geokniga 4448, JPG 4404x4740, 200 dpi, ~25 m/px); fill = map tint (legend swatch #bac0ab); lakes print in a grey-teal 10-14 dE from lpIV, so no WATER row (lakes read as lpIV); classified: map units only. Omitted: lalIII1 and lgII4 (swatch #dea369 / #ddc09b; on the face only a few small valley polygons, and their tints sit 6-9 dE from the glIII2zr hatch and the red hummocky-moraine grid mixture, which they captured in the dry run), and the section-only units m?III1, lalII3, m-glmI-II, glmI-II and pre-Quaternary. Red overprints (hummocky-moraine grid, kame cross-hatch, eskers) are not separate units: the base colour between the lines is classified
